Open questions (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md §10)
1. Landing page for v1, or straight to /login?
2. Bottom-nav labels — icons only, or icons + text? (drawn here: labels)
3. Rest timer — full-screen vs pill? (drawn here: pill)
4. Volt hue — this draft uses ~132° green. Alternatives on the table: electric indigo ~275° (frees green for success only), or amber ~70°.
